messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Oct 26, 2020, Kraus, Sebastian wrote:
>
>A) Is there mature support for Nvidia Ampere GPU microarchitecture within Amber20?
Amber20 runs on Ampere -- be sure you have applied all the updates,
especially update.6. There may be more optimizations in the future.
It's hard to call our support "mature": we simply haven't had either the
time or the access to Ampere cards to put much effort into this.
>B) Will there be an Amber21/22 release within 2021?
No. Amber releases are always in the Spring of even-numbered years.
If we do make Ampere-related improvements, they will be posted as
updates to Amber20 as they become available.
....dac
